formal.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

independent.method: Absolute finite periodic source prefixes; original-input-derived B attempts and effective charging; sparse discharge/pulse resource accounts; closed-form clipped cooling between heat-event anchors. All actual frames, complete intervals, lock and terminal outcomes and receipt copies are compared. No Model/pilot import, per-tick thermal integration, search or new gameplay.
limitations: Only the root-approved first six actual public ordinary cases. Formal synthetic boundaries, browser controls, pause/retry, rendering and video are separate evidence.

Serialized observations prove values and historical copies, not object identity or Object.freeze. Only the two append-only receipt arrays use prefixes; mutable locks and ledgers remain full observations.
Integer energy, heat, times, IDs and all threshold comparisons have zero tolerance. Elapsed time is derived from the explicitly parsed 60 Hz unit and also compared exactly.

The necessary-energy failure is independently derived from optimistic remaining finite supply and minimum outstanding payments plus reserve; a nonnegative margin is not a proof that every such state can win.
Original recorded keys and public input latch semantics are checked; unencountered cancellation, pressed aliases, pause, dt0 and invalid-dt behavior are not synthesized.

Observed coverage is counted only from this corpus. Original raw/source hashes are bound via the approved lossless public manifest without reading diagnostic-bearing originals or production implementations.

candidate.scope: Only actual public snapshots and detached discharge/pulse receipts. Sparse browser trace is not a full 60 Hz stream. Every valid active call, including the terminal call, has one real interval. charging means actual effective A in the latest interval; receipt history is not mislabeled as a current pulse. Menu prime does not advance the model. Live screenshots retain the actual A hold without issuing input or pausing.

priorAttempts.scope: Initial menu only; candidate has no gameplay trace and no normal round. No gameplay/performance acceptance.
priorAttempts.observation: Original1280x720 image personally viewed. Glyphs remain legible; recorded DOM text-range rectangles overlap vertically by about0.703px. Full blueprint, primary/scenario controls, sidebar and version visibly fit. Preserve strict check and add2px margin below lock labels.
priorAttempts.correctionScope: Full exact difference reviewed: one CSS margin-bottom:2px addition only; preserve strict candidate rectangle checks. Initial candidate stopped before gameplay. Formal/ordinary sources unchanged, so no rerun.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryPulseManagement.scope: Actual held-A/B dispatch edges, permanent pulse/discharge banks and sparse energy, heat, lock and supply endpoints. Wall-clock held-key intervals are not model charging durations. Complete saved receipts may include events whose transient last-event field was never sampled; those gaps remain explicit. Observed lastStep values are real one-tick intervals, including the terminal interval. No unobserved cooling tick, input or pulse is reconstructed; the full ordinary independent audit is separate. Menu preparation does not advance Model.

encodingOrderEvidence.scope: Original reception order and frame bytes retained; encoding order is stable by actual recorded timestamp with reception-index ties. Consolidation synthesizes no state or frame.

actualGameplay.observationScope: Actual browser input, permanent discharge/pulse receipts and sparse energy, heat, lock and supply observations. A held input interval is not a reconstructed model charging duration. Missing local events and sample gaps remain explicit; no cooling or input is replayed. The ordinary independent audit is separate. The approved recipe, observed win and at least eight seconds of actual terminal hold are bound. Original reception order, derived encoding mapping and real empty error arrays remain factual. The existing full decode is reused once. Candidate label-spacing failure is retained separately; no recording recovery or physical-device test is claimed.

ordinaryCaseSourceHistory.scope: First six actual ordinary-input cases. Public projections omit only pilotDiagnostics; original/source hashes remain bound. Consolidation replays no game.

preservedFailedAttempts.scope: Initial menu only; candidate has no gameplay trace and no normal round. No gameplay/performance acceptance.

candidateAttemptHistory.scope: Initial menu-only candidate failed a strict DOM Range separation check before gameplay. Root and QA saw legible glyphs; a 2px CSS label gap was added without relaxing the check. Original failure/build/source and the accepted second candidate remain separate. This is not a recording failure or recovery.

actualGameplay.encodedSelectionScope: Nine unmodified encoded images selected after capture from actual periodic observations: three menus, collected-pulse history while currently charging before the first lock, one opened lock, multiple opened locks, all locks open while reserve is still insufficient, current charging and an observed win after at least two seconds of terminal hold. A pulse-history label does not claim the image catches the instantaneous pulse. Narrow current-state predicates reserve distinct samples before broad charging/history picks; extraction is sorted by actual selected time. Actual lock references, discharge/pulse histories, energy/thermal ledgers and finite supply are retained without inventing unseen intervals or future capture states. Every terminal lastStep retains its real one-tick interval, with host and model ticks separate. Missing manifests or stage samples block extraction; no post-dispatch edge selection, extra Model run, recapture or automatic replacement. Original received order and the complete stable encoding-order mapping remain bound. The recommended gameplay frame is only a candidate for the later cover, never copied into source here. Every image semantic awaits personal review.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
